reason: States that the fruit or its commissure has no oil canals. The vitta anatomy class FLOPO_0986042 already exists, so this is the complement of has_part some vitta.

The sources mix two senses: nearly strap-shaped blades and segments (≈ strap-shaped PATO_0002430 with the 'sub-' approximate value) and Asteraceae florets that are almost ligulate, which is a floret type. Without a rule that separates them by bearer, the word is ambiguous.

Neither PO nor FLOPO has a stinging-hair class. Stating that the broader glandular trichome (PO_0004509) is absent would wrongly deny all glandular hairs. A stinging-hair anatomy class under glandular trichome is needed first.

target: new: free portion of a partly fused part
reason: A length (PATO_0000122 with a measurement) of the unfused portion of a filament or peduncle. The bearer is a region defined by not being adnate, which no class covers.

target: docs/annotation-context-patterns.md (place on the part, kind C: margin) with green (PATO_0000320)
reason: The colour green belongs to the margin of the sepal or perigynium, not to the whole part. This is the region-of-the-bearer pattern.

target: new: two attributes that both hold, on a region (margin): silvery (FLOPO_0980092) and transparent (PATO_0000964)
reason: Combines a colour and a transparency of the margin or apex. Both values hold together, so it is neither a continuum nor an alternative. PATO_0000964 transparent has the synonym hyaline.
A count in a word: two awns (awn PO_0025349, count 2), as 'aristate' is the rule for awn present.

This describes the shape (square, PATO_0000413) of the surface cells of a moss costa in its apical part, not a quality of the costa. It needs a cell bearer and a region, and there is too little data to justify a rule.
A relational quality with its second term given: parallel to (PATO_0002272) towards costa (PO_0030072).

Means 'clearly distinct from the adjacent cells or lamina', which is relational (PATO_0005006 differentiated from) with the second term only implied. The previous review rejected such words (contiguous, similar).

target: new: vague count of parts (several, many, few) — extension of docs/odp/03-count-of-parts.md
reason: A count of seeds in a word ('several-seeded'). Pattern 03 holds counts without a number, so a vague-count extension is needed.

target: new: vague count of parts (several, many, few) — extension of docs/odp/03-count-of-parts.md
reason: 'Many-seeded': a count of seeds without a number, the same reading as pluriseeded.

target: new: vague count of parts (several, many, few) — extension of docs/odp/03-count-of-parts.md
reason: An inflorescence made of few fascicles: a vague count, like 'few-flowered'.
Spelling variant of pyriform. The previous review mapped pyriform to PATO_0005002 (C203).
Wind pollination is a process (an ecological mode), not a morphological quality of the flower. A process quality on a plant part conflicts with FLOPO's process-quality GCI.
The calyx is as long as the corolla: equality of length with another part.
A hyphenated compound of two shape values, cuneate (PATO_0001955) and rounded. It is read as a continuum, like linear-lanceolate.
Hypocrateriform (misspelled here) is the Latin/French term for salverform: a slender tube abruptly expanded into a flat limb.
French for inclined, which the previous review mapped to PATO_0002481 (C338). 'Inclinées vers le bas' could be more precisely descending (FLOPO:0991207).
French 'replié' means folded back on itself (margins, auricles, style). PATO_0001910 folded fits: one part layered over a connected part.
French 'saillant' for veins means projecting from the surface, which matches PATO_0001482. PATO_0001369 raised is defined for colonies and does not fit.

target: new: spacing of like parts (distance PATO_0000040 to the next part of the same kind, with measurement)
reason: A measured distance between neighbouring veins or flowers. Distance is relational, and its second term is the next member of the same series.

The two sides of the leaflet base differ, i.e. an oblique, asymmetric base. Annotate asymmetrical on the base (plant organ base FLOPO_0985024). FLOPO:0991101 unequal would need the set of the two sides as its bearer.
A seed with a fleshy outer seed coat (sarcotesta). The quality fleshy inheres in the testa (PO_0020057), not in the whole seed.
A count in a word: a fruit of one coccus (mericarp PO_0020075, count 1), usually by abortion.
A hyphenated compound of two shape values (rounded; nearly square, PATO_0000413 with the approximate qualifier), read as a continuum.
Long soft hairs confined to tufts at nodes or at the apex of the back: this is bearded, defined as long hairs confined to a tuft, line or zone.
Bracts and leaf tips that are withered and contracted through loss of moisture in life, which matches PATO_0002460. Not the specimen condition 'when dry'.
The veins of the bract or rachilla stand out from the surface. Prominent inheres in the veins (vascular bundle PO_0005020) of the part, as in the 'distinct veins' rule C176.
A spelling without the hyphen of spine-tipped, which already exists as FLOPO:0991210.
